messages:
Fiona (Finance): Quick note 1: Product wants to run a 2-arm A/B for mid-market next week. Need decisions on grandfathering, invoice metadata, and mid-cycle cohort moves. Looping in @Marco @Ruth.

Dana (Product): Plan: control = current list, variant = +10% with earlier stepdown. Target 5% for 3 weeks. Want experiment_id on export rows only. No PDF changes.

Marco (Billing Ops): Ops: we can add experiment_id to billing_export easily. For mid-cycle flips I recommend provisional prorate on invoice + month-end recon and auto-credit for deltas < $30. Corrected invoice if gateway supports it for > $30.

Ruth (Legal): Grandfathering: propose 90 days for general customers, 120 days auto-extension for strategic accounts (> $50k ARR). Need short customer wording and opt-out path.

Fiona (Finance): Agreed. Quick poll: react :one: for 90d, :two: for 120d default.

Dana (Product): :one: (90d)

Marco (Billing Ops): :two: (ops prefers 120d for stability)

Ruth (Legal): :one: but OK with 120d for strategic accounts.

payments-bot: Chargebee note: invoice.custom_fields available; corrected invoice not supported as a single API call. Workaround = credit_note + new invoice.

Fiona (Finance): Conclusion: experiment_id on exports = yes; invoice PDFs = no; grandfathering = 90d general, 120d for strategic; mid-cycle = provisional prorate + recon; Marco to draft runbook and confirm Chargebee workaround. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
